verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ כִּי־ ט֭וֹב זַמְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־ נָ֝עִים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū yāh kî- ṭō·wḇ zam·mə·rāh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū kî- nā·‘îm nā·wāh ṯə·hil·lāh
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . How good it is to sing praises to our God how pleasant and lovely to praise Him
verses.literalPt: Louvai a Jeová! Bom é cantar louvores a nosso Deus, pois é agradável; decoroso é o louvor.

verses.original: בּוֹנֵ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה נִדְחֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יְכַנֵּֽס׃
verses.transliteration: bō·w·nêh yə·rū·šā·lim Yah·weh niḏ·ḥê yiś·rā·’êl yə·ḵan·nês
verses.literal: The LORD builds up Jerusalem He gathers the exiles of Israel
verses.literalPt: Jeová edifica a Jerusalém, congrega os dispersos de Israel.

verses.original: הָ֭רֹפֵא לִשְׁב֣וּרֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מְחַבֵּ֗שׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rō·p̄ê liš·ḇū·rê lêḇ ū·mə·ḥab·bêš lə·‘aṣ·ṣə·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: He heals the brokenhearted . . . and binds up their wounds
verses.literalPt: Ele sara os quebrantados de coração e ata-lhes as feridas.

verses.original: מוֹנֶ֣ה מִ֭סְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִ֑ים לְ֝כֻלָּ֗ם שֵׁמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: mō·w·neh mis·pār lak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm lə·ḵul·lām šê·mō·wṯ yiq·rā
verses.literal: He determines the number of the stars He calls them each by name
verses.literalPt: Conta o número das estrelas e a todas elas dá nome.

verses.original: גָּד֣וֹל אֲדוֹנֵ֣ינוּ וְרַב־ כֹּ֑חַ לִ֝תְבוּנָת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: gā·ḏō·wl ’ă·ḏō·w·nê·nū wə·raḇ- kō·aḥ liṯ·ḇū·nā·ṯōw ’ên mis·pār
verses.literal: Great is our Lord and mighty in power His understanding has no limit
verses.literalPt: Grande é o nosso Senhor e mui poderoso; o seu entendimento é infinito.

verses.original: מְעוֹדֵ֣ד עֲנָוִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה מַשְׁפִּ֖יל רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֲדֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·‘ō·w·ḏêḏ ‘ă·nā·wîm Yah·weh maš·pîl rə·šā·‘îm ‘ă·ḏê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The LORD sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground
verses.literalPt: Jeová ampara os humildes; dá em terra com os perversos.

verses.original: עֱנ֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּתוֹדָ֑ה זַמְּר֖וּ לֵאלֹהֵ֣ינוּ בְכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ĕ·nū Yah·weh bə·ṯō·w·ḏāh zam·mə·rū lê·lō·hê·nū ḇə·ḵin·nō·wr
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving make music on the harp to our God
verses.literalPt: Cantai a Jeová com ação de graças; com a harpa, cantai louvores a nosso Deus,

verses.original: הַֽמְכַסֶּ֬ה שָׁמַ֨יִם׀ בְּעָבִ֗ים הַמֵּכִ֣ין לָאָ֣רֶץ מָטָ֑ר הַמַּצְמִ֖יחַ הָרִ֣ים חָצִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ham·ḵas·seh šā·ma·yim bə·‘ā·ḇîm ham·mê·ḵîn lā·’ā·reṣ mā·ṭār ham·maṣ·mî·aḥ hā·rîm ḥā·ṣîr
verses.literal: who covers the sky with clouds who prepares rain for the earth who makes grass to grow on the hills
verses.literalPt: que cobre de nuvens o céu, que prepara a chuva para a terra, que faz brotar nos montes a erva.

verses.original: נוֹתֵ֣ן לִבְהֵמָ֣ה לַחְמָ֑הּ לִבְנֵ֥י עֹ֝רֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·w·ṯên liḇ·hê·māh laḥ·māh liḇ·nê ‘ō·rêḇ ’ă·šer yiq·rā·’ū
verses.literal: He provides food for the animals and for the young ravens when they call
verses.literalPt: Ao gado dá o alimento e aos filhos dos corvos que clamam.

verses.original: לֹ֤א בִגְבוּרַ֣ת הַסּ֣וּס יֶחְפָּ֑ץ לֹֽא־ בְשׁוֹקֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ יִרְצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ḇiḡ·ḇū·raṯ has·sūs yeḥ·pāṣ lō- ḇə·šō·w·qê hā·’îš yir·ṣeh
verses.literal: He does not delight in the strength of the horse He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man
verses.literalPt: Não se compraz na força do cavalo, nem se deleita nas pernas do homem.

verses.original: רוֹצֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ יְרֵאָ֑יו אֶת־ הַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: rō·w·ṣeh Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·rê·’āw ’eṯ- ham·ya·ḥă·lîm lə·ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him who hope in His loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Jeová deleita-se nos que o temem, nos que esperam na sua benignidade.

verses.original: שַׁבְּחִ֣י יְ֭רוּשָׁלִַם אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה הַֽלְלִ֖י אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: šab·bə·ḥî yə·rū·šā·lim ’eṯ- Yah·weh hal·lî ’ĕ·lō·ha·yiḵ ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Exalt the LORD O Jerusalem praise your God O Zion
verses.literalPt: Louva, Jerusalém, a Jeová; louva, Sião, ao teu Deus.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חִ֭זַּק בְּרִיחֵ֣י שְׁעָרָ֑יִךְ בֵּרַ֖ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥiz·zaq bə·rî·ḥê šə·‘ā·rā·yiḵ bê·raḵ bā·na·yiḵ bə·qir·bêḵ
verses.literal: For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you
verses.literalPt: Pois ele fortaleceu as trancas das tuas portas; abençoou os teus filhos dentro de ti.

verses.original: הַשָּׂם־ גְּבוּלֵ֥ךְ שָׁל֑וֹם חֵ֥לֶב חִ֝טִּ֗ים יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śām- gə·ḇū·lêḵ šā·lō·wm ḥê·leḇ ḥiṭ·ṭîm yaś·bî·‘êḵ
verses.literal: He makes peace at your borders He fills you with the finest wheat
verses.literalPt: Ele é quem põe em paz os teus termos, quem te farta de flor de farinha de trigo,

verses.original: הַשֹּׁלֵ֣חַ אִמְרָת֣וֹ אָ֑רֶץ עַד־ מְ֝הֵרָ֗ה יָר֥וּץ דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šō·lê·aḥ ’im·rā·ṯōw ’ā·reṣ ‘aḏ- mə·hê·rāh yā·rūṣ də·ḇā·rōw
verses.literal: He sends forth His command to the earth His word runs swiftly
verses.literalPt: quem sobre a terra envia o seu mandado. A sua palavra corre mui velozmente.

verses.original: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן שֶׁ֣לֶג כַּצָּ֑מֶר כְּ֝פ֗וֹר כָּאֵ֥פֶר יְפַזֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: han·nō·ṯên še·leḡ kaṣ·ṣā·mer kə·p̄ō·wr kā·’ê·p̄er yə·p̄az·zêr
verses.literal: He spreads the snow like wool He scatters the frost like ashes
verses.literalPt: Ele dá a neve como lã e espalha a geada como cinza.

verses.original: מַשְׁלִ֣יךְ קַֽרְח֣וֹ כְפִתִּ֑ים לִפְנֵ֥י קָ֝רָת֗וֹ מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: maš·lîḵ qar·ḥōw ḵə·p̄it·tîm lip̄·nê qā·rā·ṯōw mî ya·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: He casts forth His hail like pebbles Who can withstand . . . His icy blast
verses.literalPt: Ele arroja o seu gelo em migalhas. Quem pode resistir ao seu frio?

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּבָר֣וֹ וְיַמְסֵ֑ם יַשֵּׁ֥ב ר֝וּח֗וֹ יִזְּלוּ־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·laḥ də·ḇā·rōw wə·yam·sêm yaš·šêḇ rū·ḥōw yiz·zə·lū- mā·yim
verses.literal: He sends forth His word and melts them He unleashes His winds and the waters flow
verses.literalPt: Ele envia a sua palavra e os derrete; faz soprar o seu vento, e as águas correm.

verses.original: מַגִּ֣יד דְּבָרוֹ לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב חֻקָּ֥יו וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטָ֗יו לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mag·gîḏ də·ḇå̄·rō lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ḥuq·qāw ū·miš·pā·ṭāw lə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: He declares His word to Jacob His statutes and judgments to Israel
verses.literalPt: Ele manifesta a sua palavra a Jacó e os seus estatutos e os seus juízos, a Israel.

verses.original: לֹ֘א עָ֤שָׂה כֵ֨ן׀ לְכָל־ גּ֗וֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֥ים בַּל־ יְדָע֗וּם הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ‘ā·śāh ḵên lə·ḵāl gō·w ū·miš·pā·ṭîm bal- yə·ḏā·‘ūm hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: He has done this for no other . . . nation they do not know His judgments Hallelujah . . .
verses.literalPt: Ele não tem procedido assim com nação alguma; e, quanto aos seus juízos, elas não os conhecem. Louvai a Jeová!
